Body.Content:
Enable Project and Item Requirement Delivery Address Management

This feature extends delivery address capabilities within integrated Project Operations by introducing delivery address support on Project, Project Task, and Material Estimate records. Delivery addresses can be selected from customer addresses, defaulted through the project hierarchy, and synchronized between Dataverse and Finance and Operations.

The enhancement also ensures that delivery addresses are correctly resolved and populated on Item Requirements regardless of how they are created, whether from Item Forecasts, Project Purchase Orders, or directly from Projects. This provides a consistent and controlled address management experience across project planning, procurement, and fulfillment processes.

GA date: January CY2028

Preview date: January CY2027
